### Changed
- **The serving preset catalog is published wherever the connectivity chart runs, model serving off included** (giantswarm/agent-platform#847). The ServingPreset ConfigMaps (`agent-platform.giantswarm.io/serving-preset=true`, with the `agent-platform.giantswarm.io/chart-version` annotation) render in the release namespace whether or not `components.modelServing.enabled` is set, from the same catalog (`files/model-serving/presets/*.yaml` plus `modelServing.presets`, `shippedPresets.enabled` / `.exclude` honoured), so model-manager's `check_fit` answers a preset's declaration before a GPU pool and its backend exist. The chat-template ConfigMaps, the discovery ConfigMap and every serving workload stay behind the switch; with it on the render is unchanged. `make verify-preset-catalog` asserts both sides.
